name: GE Vernova
outlook:
What GE Vernova says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenue, margin and free cash flowGE Vernova is raising its 2026 financial guidance and now expects revenue of $46.5-$47.5 billion, up from $45.5-$46.5 billion, adjusted EBITDA margin* of 13.5%-14.5%, up from 12%-14%, and free cash flow* of $16-$ 17 billion, up from $11.5-$12.5 billion.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 28, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
